display_name: Vertical enterprise SaaS (seed to Series A)
persona: Growth or multi-stage fund diligencing regulated or niche B2B software.
use_case: Run thesis → discovery → scoring on companies selling into a specific vertical (e.g. construction, logistics).
thesis_raw: Seed-stage B2B SaaS selling into construction and built-world verticals; must show pilots with mid-market or enterprise GCs and clear path to $1M ARR.
sample_chat_prompts: What metrics matter most for vertical SaaS at seed?
How do I think about TAM for niche construction software?
What questions should I ask a founder about enterprise sales cycles in construction tech?

demo_notes.mock_mode: Pipeline output still uses the shared developer-tools fixture for candidates (deterministic demo data). Your thesis text appears in parsed output raw field and headers.
demo_notes.live_mode: Discovery and LLM steps use your thesis content; outputs will reflect vertical SaaS–aligned companies when data APIs return results.
